title: Loi sur la Regie de l'energie (Act respecting the Regie de l'energie)
verified_how: NOT verified against the register: www.legisquebec.gouv.qc.ca refused every request with HTTP 403 from Amazon CloudFront ('Request blocked'), so neither the register's own title page nor its 'a jour au' date could be read. The French title and RLRQ chapter number recorded here are corroborated only by LegisQuebec page titles and PDF headings that appeared in web-search results (e.g. 'chapitre R-6.01 LOI SUR LA REGIE DE L'ENERGIE'), which is not a substitute for the register.
notes: The Regie de l'energie fixes the tarifs et conditions de service (rates and conditions of service) for Hydro-Quebec's distribution activity and for natural-gas distributors under this Act. Bill 69 of the 2025 session, on energy-resource governance, amended it - a further reason the consolidation date must be re-checked on LegisQuebec.
